fusions.name: Wire Whip
fusions.desc: Cracks a stiff strand that deals 5 damage to one enemy within 7 tiles. Deals up to 1.5 times as much at maximum range.

fusions.name: Bar Sweep
fusions.desc: Swings stiff strands round you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Drawn Shield
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 28 damage and raises your armour by 8%, both for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Woven Mail
fusions.desc: Conjures armour of drawn strands: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12% plus a further 4%, and 10% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
